atoms.title: The Xylophone
atoms.b: The xylophone is a percussion instrument. To play a note, you hit the instrument to make it vibrate.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-xylophone-2</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> The xylophone is a percussion instrument. To play a note, you hit the instrument to make it vibrate.

atoms.b: The xylophone consists of many tone bars that are made of wood. We use mallets to strike the tone bars.

instruction.text: What does a xylophone look like?

atoms.title: How do you play the xylophone?
atoms.b: Each tone bar has its own sound. The smaller bars play a higher tone. The larger bars play a lower tone.
You play the xylophone with one or two mallets in each hand. This means it is possible to play up to four tones at the same time.
